routes.label: a renewal on expiry, at an identification office
a duplicate after a loss, theft or damage, at an identification office

note: The President signed a decree on 2 February 2025 making the biometric national identity card free (the Council of Ministers' minutes of 27 February 2025, on the Government's site, read 2026-11-03). The ministries' communiqué, as Guinéenews reported it (27 March 2025), limits it to a first request from 16: a renewal on expiry, a duplicate after a loss, theft or damage, and a child under 16 still pay, a child at the old tariff. Until then a first card was held at GNF 15,000 at every age, from Decree D/95/254/PRG/SGG of 1995 and the 2008 order on fees as the IRB of Canada's response quoted them (a stamp duty of 5,000 and an issuing fee of 10,000, summed); that now holds only at 15. What a renewal or a duplicate costs from 16 isn't stated, so it's null. The decree of 2025 itself wasn't found; the card is compulsory from 15 (art. 3) and valid five years (art. 2) in the 1995 decree, held still; the time isn't stated.

sources.title: Immigration and Refugee Board of Canada, Guinea: National identity card (2011-2014), on ecoi.net
sources.said: The national identity card is mandatory for all citizens from fifteen (15) years of age (Guinea 1995, art. 3) The national identity card is valid for a renewable term of five (5) years and is issued only to Guinean nationals (ibid., Art. 2). ... Duty on stamp to be applied = 5,000 Guinean francs (GNF) [C$0.80] Fee for issuing the national identity card = 10,000 GNF [C$1.60]

sources.title: Gouvernement guinéen, Compte rendu de la session ordinaire du Conseil des ministres du jeudi 27 février 2025
sources.said: Par ailleurs, le Président de la République a rappelé que, le 2 février 2025, il a signé un décret pour la gratuité de la carte nationale d’identité biométrique . Dans ce cadre, il a décidé personnellement de financer cette gratuité sur son budget de souveraineté.

sources.title: Guinéenews, Carte d’identité gratuite en Guinée pour la première demande (27 mars 2025)
sources.said: Désormais, toute première demande de CNI biométrique sera gratuite pour les citoyens guinéens âgés de 16 ans et plus. ... la gratuité ne s’applique pas: – Aux demandes de renouvellement (en cas d’expiration de la carte) ; – Aux duplicatas (en cas de perte, vol ou détérioration) ; – Aux mineurs de moins de 16 ans, qui restent soumis aux anciennes conditions tarifaires.
